description: Hash table with keys of any type, insertion order and `size`. `get`, `set`, `has` and `delete` are O(1) on average.
Collection of unique values in insertion order. `has` is O(1), which makes it the tool for membership checks and deduplication.
A lookup structure built once (`new Map(items.map(i => [i.id, i]))`) so later lookups do not scan the list.
Built-in grouping (Node 21+): `Map.groupBy(items, item => key)` returns a Map from key to the items with that key.
Writing user-controlled keys such as `__proto__` into a plain object alters `Object.prototype`. A `Map` has no such keys.
`union`, `intersection`, `difference` and `isSubsetOf` on `Set` (Node 22+): ideal for computing what was added or removed.
